Name: Perdition
Overview:
Imprisoned for life... Sentenced to death... One chance of escape...

Perdition is a dark fantasy hack-and-slash adventure by Amalgamation Softworks. Carve a bloody path across the dungeon as you evade traps, fight monsters, and search for items. Reach the surface and you will know freedom. Linger in the dark places and only death will find you.

Can you survive?
